card.name: Endings of proper surnames
card.fires_on: The final piece of a person's or place's proper name, such as the end of Orellana, Mallory or Castellana, or the surname Hillary after Edmund. It appears in general web text, not drug text.

modes.label: Split surname ending
modes.description: The last piece of a surname or place name that was split into parts, such as -ana, -ory or -ano.
modes.example: When George Mall<<ory>>, the British climber was asked why

modes.label: Hillary after Edmund
modes.description: The surname Hillary right after Edmund, referring to the Everest climber.
modes.example: The airport was built in 1964 by Sir Edmund<< Hillary>> as part of his project in Khumb

card.plain: It fires at the end of a person's or place's proper name, especially Everest names like Mallory and Hillary.
